_what: 전구간정상 G2 under the DECLARED window — the cell PR #214 left open. That PR measured the empty handover twice and got 4 of 6 on the default, with the two departures going opposite ways (`b` once, `c` once): wobble, not drift. It named two suspects and could only rule out one by hand. The first was FIXTURE RESIDUE — its manual protocol had to stand in for the narrated window, and one departing sample cited `(변화 없음)`, a string no real run puts there. A declared window has no stand-in, so this run discriminates: if the default holds at N=10 here, the residue was the cause; if it wobbles the same way, the wobble belongs to the gate and 2 of 3 is the honest number.

authoring_choices: TIMELINE_EXCERPT is G2's declared `excerpt` (t6 · t9 · t10) resolved on an EMPTY-handover run. t9 asks for `logs_opened`, which only a run that pressed at G1 sets, so it drops here and the window is two rows. That is the measured condition — a first run reads a thinner window than a run that intervened, and this suite measures the first run.

The window is still ABOUT the closure delay while the question asks about cargo. That mismatch is deliberate and it is measured, not overlooked: PR #214 pushed 규칙 6 to demand an on-topic window, authored a 21:17 row to supply one, and the k2 injection collapsed from 3/3 to 1/3. The rule was retracted to what the measurement supports. Re-authoring the window on-topic here would repeat a dead experiment.
The live arm injects k2's first example (CCTV · 시계 21:07). Its mined row t7 is deliberately absent from the window — W5's rule, and the reason the arm can test anything at all.
Everything else — temperament fixture, default-prompt slots, stance-label provenance — matches EXC-G1-declared-window so the three gates stay comparable.

pre_registration.hypothesis: At G2 on the declared window, an empty handover takes the default stance `a` (진술 접수) more often than PR #214's hand-measured 4 of 6, because the declared window removes the fixture residue that was the leading suspect. A k2 sentence in BLOCKS moves the modal stance to `b` (적재 추궁), as it did 3 of 3 by hand.
pre_registration.drop_condition: This suite CANNOT be dropped for a non-`a` baseline — a wobbling baseline is the finding it was built to characterise. It is dropped only if the live arm fails to move the modal stance off `a`, which would mean the key is not reaching cl1 at this gate and the k2 result would have to be re-derived before any G2 conclusion stands.
contingencies: 8 or more of 10 on `a` closes the cell in favour of the residue hypothesis: the manual protocol was measuring its own fixture, and the gate is sound.

6 or 7 of 10 on `a` with departures still going both ways reproduces the wobble on a clean payload. Then the wobble is the gate's own, 2 of 3 is honest, and the remaining lever is the stance set — not the window, which is now authored.

A departure that cites a sentence NOT in the two-row window is worth reading closely: on a declared window there is nowhere for such a sentence to come from except the model, and that is a different finding.
Fabricated because_block_ids in the baseline arm are expected and are not discards.
pre_registration.not_claimed: No placebo arm. This does not test whether a same-axis misdirected sentence leaves the gate unmoved; it re-measures two cells one design change was predicted to affect, and the prediction is stated above so it can fail.
